_notes.setup_guide: Full console setup (rules, this index, TTL policy, Cloudinary, push) is documented in docs/firebase-setup.md.
_notes.location_shares_ttl: Firestore TTL policies require the Blaze plan (403 billing disabled on Spark). Expiry is handled entirely client-side by FriendService.purgeExpiredLocationShares(), which sweeps both toUid and fromUid. See docs/firebase-setup.md.
_notes.location_shares_rules: Both parties may delete a share: the recipient from the list UI, either side during the client-side expiry sweep. See firestore.rules.
